newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH CSOB CZK 6 BLN 5-YR BOND TO BE PLACED AT PAR.
newsitem.headline: CZECH CSOB CZK 6 BLN 5-YR BOND TO BE PLACED AT PAR.

text.p: Prague-based Ceskoslovenska Obchodni Banka a.s. (CSOB) said on Monday that it would place a six billion crown issue of five-year domestic bonds with a variable coupon at 10 basis points over the Prague Interbank Offered Rate (PRIBOR).
Zbynek Solecky of the bank's primary markets division told Reuters that the issue would be priced at par and placed with a syndicate organised by his bank.
"We will turn to investors with the offer and from the received orders we will assemble a syndicate," he said.
Issue date has been set for July 15.
The coupon, which is pegged to the six-month PRIBOR, will be paid semi-annually, the bank said in a statement.
